origin: New Guinea, Cape York, offshore islands
temperament: Arboreal, defensive when disturbed, best appreciated visually
blurb: Locality is everything. Biak, Sorong, Aru, Manokwari and Cyclops lines each carry a distinct adult expression, and a proven high-blue animal is among the most valuable serpents ever sold.

care.feedingAdult: One small rodent every 14–21 days; do not overfeed
care.notes: Perch diameter must match body girth. Ontogenetic colour change from neonate yellow or red to adult green completes between 6 and 14 months.
